title: Summarize output
description: Output of the Sonnet summarize prompt — one object per top-N paper.

problem.description: The specific gap or question the paper addresses.

key_result.description: The headline finding, with numerical claims when available.

why_it_matters.description: Why the operator should (or should not) care, addressed to their interests.

novelty_signal.description: Where this paper sits on the novelty spectrum. The label describes the paper's claim, not the model's endorsement.

cross_domain_hooks.description: Genuine intellectual bridges to candidate papers from other domains. Empty array is correct when none of the candidates form a substantive bridge.

arxiv_id.description: arXiv ID of the candidate paper this hook references.

connection.description: Specific intellectual bridge — what idea travels and why it matters.

strength.description: Bridge strength. 'weak' = barely worth mentioning. 'strong' = operator should consider reading the candidate.

tags.description: 2–5 lowercase-hyphenated topical tags. Avoid jargon stacking.
